item.tib: zab lam mkha' 'gro 'bum rdzogs ma rgyud gsas mkhar sde lnga'i rgyud skong rgyud bskang
item.coloph: de ltar zab lam ma rgyud dgongs pa kun 'dus gsas mkhar sde lnga'i tshogs byang gi cha rkyen rgyud bskangs (skong) zad med gter chen 'di nyid bla ma'i bka' dang nye gnas tshul khrims blo ldan nas rab dkar lha gos dang bcas te bskur ngor spa rigs dge sbyong g.yung drung bstan pa 'brug grags pas bris pas shu b+haM//
